tasks.prompt: Specialized foreign-trade proactive lead generation and outreach workflow. Use when the user wants to find overseas B2B customers from a natural-language request, product image, product description, customer table, or wants customer research, lead qualification, WhatsApp/email/contact extraction guidance, tabular lead reports, or personalized cold emails for importers, wholesalers, distributors, retailers, e-commerce sellers, procurement teams, factories, SOHO exporters, Yiwu sellers, and 1688 merchants.

verifier.note: a skill describes a procedure; it carries no ground truth

refusals.why: skills document procedures, not expected end states; tasks derived from them must be authored and gated separately
